edges.reason: relayTokens delegates the full bridging logic to the internal _relayTokens routine.
relayTokens with a single value forwards msg.sender as receiver into _relayTokens.
The user supplied token address is used for an external transferFrom call before the message id is stored.
The caller address is the source of the token pull and the recorded message sender inside _relayTokens.
After the token pull, _relayTokens invokes bridgeSpecificActionsOnTokenTransfer to burn and pass the message.
The home bridge action burns the value and then calls passMessage to notify the other network.
passMessage performs an external call into the AMB bridge while the transfer metadata is only stored afterwards.
A malicious ERC677 token can re-enter onTokenTransfer from inside the transferFrom call of _relayTokens.
onTokenTransfer validates the transferred amount through the withinLimit view check.
withinLimit reads the current day through getCurrentDay when accumulating the daily spent amount.
getCurrentDay derives the day number directly from block.timestamp, making limits time dependent.
addTotalSpentPerDay resolves the current day through getCurrentDay before writing the counter.
The onlyMediator handler forwards the incoming token, recipient and value to _handleBridgedTokens.
When the value is inside the execution limit the bridged token action is executed.
executeActionOnBridgedTokens performs an external mint on the home token contract.
The foreign to home fee is computed through _distributeFee before minting the remainder.
Fee distribution performs an external ERC677 transfer per reward address, allowing a malicious token to re-enter.
Fee distribution performs an external mint per reward address in the foreign to home direction.
The freshly deployed token proxy is passed to _handleBridgedTokens for the mint execution.
fixFailedMessage marks the message as fixed and calls executeActionOnFixedTokens to roll back assets.
Rolling back a failed message performs an external mint to the original recipient.
requestFailedMessageFix sends a fix request through the AMB bridge external call.
fixMediatorBalance forwards forced-in balances through the AMB bridge external call.
fixMediatorBalance caps the pushed amount with the withinLimit view check.
claimTokens dispatches to claimValues for native coins or unregistered ERC20 tokens.
Claiming native coins performs an unstyled external native send to a caller supplied address.
setDailyLimit is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier that compares msg.sender with the stored owner.
setFee is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier that compares msg.sender with the stored owner.
_releaseTokens may externally mint STAKE tokens to the recipient or to the mediator.
_releaseTokens performs a safeTransfer of the bridged token to the recipient before the stored balance is updated.
The incoming value parameter initializes the local valueToBridge variable.
The local valueToBridge is the amount used to compute the distributed fee.
The receiver parameter is encoded into the AMB payload built by passMessage.
The from parameter is supplied by the token contract into the onTokenTransfer callback.
The from parameter is stored as the rollback recipient by bridgeSpecificActionsOnTokenTransfer.
The token parameter selects the contract on which transferFrom is executed.
fixMediatorBalance computes the difference between the observed and the tracked balance with a raw subtraction.
The decimals read from an arbitrary token are truncated through a raw uint8 cast before limit initialization.
The message id parameter is used to load and mark the stored transfer info inside fixFailedMessage.
onTokenTransfer treats msg.sender as the ERC677 token contract that triggered the callback.
The reentrancy lock is set around the token transferFrom call to avoid a double message on ERC677 callbacks.
onTokenTransfer reads the lock to detect reentrant invocation from the transferFrom call.
bridgeSpecificActionsOnTokenTransfer burns the bridged tokens through an external call on the token contract.
The payable fallback forwards calldata to the implementation with a raw delegatecall.

normalization_plan.reason: The bridged amount parameter is consumed by the burn and passMessage flow of bridgeSpecificActionsOnTokenTransfer.
The receiver parameter is only used to build the AMB payload inside passMessage.
The token parameter is the asset pulled through the external transferFrom call inside _relayTokens.
The sender parameter is supplied by the ERC677 callback into onTokenTransfer.
The message id parameter is used to load and mark the stored transfer info inside fixFailedMessage.
The value remaining after fee deduction flows into the external burn call of bridgeSpecificActionsOnTokenTransfer.
The local fee variable is the value returned by the _distributeFee routine.
The resolved home token address is forwarded to _handleBridgedTokens for minting.
The measured balance delta is passed as the bridged value into bridgeSpecificActionsOnTokenTransfer on the foreign side.
The locally assembled metadata strings are used by deployAndHandleBridgedTokens to create the token proxy.
